title: Why most new memecoins die on day one

scenes.narration: Most new memecoins on {Pump.fun|Pump dot fun} never see day two. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]

CoinGecko tracked {18.67 million|nearly nineteen million} of them. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] {68.67%|Nearly sixty-nine percent} made their last bonding-curve trade on launch day. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] Ninety days later, only {4.55%|four and a half percent} were still trading. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]
